personality: 4 Tactile layout (floating pill nav, rounded white cards) fused with 8 Botanical/Hand-Drawn organic color palette (sage/mint green)
personality_one_liner: A fresh, visually striking bookkeeping tool for plant shops that feels like a modern wellness app rather than a boring spreadsheet.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards have ample inner padding. The floating pill nav needs specific bottom inset.

do's: Use frosted glass on the Login screen Google button.
Apply slight blur to sticky headers if content scrolls beneath.
The bottom pill nav can optionally be solid dark green or heavy frosted dark green, but FAB must be solid pink.
dont's: Do not blur standard white cards on the dashboard.
Do not use glass for text inputs.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: A striking, trend-2026 entry point that drops all unnecessary text in favor of raw visual appeal and a single CTA.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of red/green Aglaonema leaves (dark cinematic macro shot). Heavy dark gradient scrim from top to bottom (transparent to 80% black/dark green at the bottom). Top-aligned: Huge 'folio' wordmark in Outfit font (white), with 'lembar pembukuan penjualan aglonema' in smaller muted white below it. Bottom-aligned (above safe area): A single large frosted glass pill button for Google Sign-in with the text 'Masuk untuk mulai'. ALL OTHER TEXT IS REMOVED.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Overview of business health with quick access to Supplier management and Excel export.
screens.layout: Soft sage background. Header contains 'Ekspor' button at the top right. Large white Profile card. 2-column grid of metric tiles (sales, stock, etc.). A dedicated full-width white card for 'Supplier' management entry point. Content scrolls behind the floating pill nav.

screens.name: Pesanan
screens.purpose: List of orders and entry point for creating new ones.

states.empty: Illustration of a clipboard with 'Belum ada pesanan'.

screens.layout: List of white cards detailing orders (date, items, total). The '+' FAB in the center of the bottom nav opens a full-screen modal (stack screen) for 'Pesanan Baru' (New Order Form) containing receiver info, cart of plants, cost & transfer recap.

screens.name: Persediaan

states.empty: Illustration of an empty pot with 'Persediaan kosong'.

screens.layout: List of inventory items. Each item is a white card showing current stock and incoming batches.

screens.name: Customer
screens.purpose: Track goods sent to specific customers.

states.empty: Illustration of a delivery box with 'Belum ada data customer'.

screens.layout: List of customers with their total orders/goods-out.

login_background.alt: A cinematic macro shot of an Aglaonema plant with red and green leaves on dark textile

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT FLOATING PILL NAVIGATION EXACTLY: The bottom tab bar must be a floating absolute container (inset left/right 24px, bottom 32px), with `brandPrimary` (#1F5A41) background and `pill` radius. It should contain 5 slots: Dashboard, Pesanan, (Empty space for FAB), Persediaan, Customer.

FAB PLACEMENT: The '+' button MUST be a large circular pink (`brandSecondary`: #C42F5C) FAB that floats exactly in the center, slightly overlapping the top edge of the dark green pill navigation bar. This FAB triggers the full-screen 'Pesanan Baru' form.

ACTIVE TAB STATE: The active tab must be a white pill (`surfaceSecondary`) containing BOTH the icon and label in dark green (`brandPrimary`). Inactive tabs display only the icon in translucent white (e.g., `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)`).

LOGIN SCREEN TREND 2026: Strictly follow the layout instructions for the Login screen. Use the provided 'login_background' image full-bleed. Apply a heavy gradient scrim over it. Remove all text fields/labels from the original design except the wordmark 'folio', tagline, and the Google 'Masuk untuk mulai' button. Make the Google button frosted glass.

TYPOGRAPHY: Use 'Outfit' for all large headings and prominent numbers. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all body text, labels, and form inputs. Ensure black/dark green text (#111A15) on the soft sage background (#F1F5F0).

SUPPLIER & EKSPOR PLACEMENT: As requested by the user, 'Supplier' is accessed via the Dashboard (e.g., a prominent card). 'Ekspor' (25-column Everpro Excel) should be a header button on the Dashboard, preventing tab bar overcrowding.
Do NOT use any blue, indigo, or purple across the app. Stick strictly to the green/pink palette defined in the color section.
